title: Extend All Functions to Return Change Instead of Diff
description: Currently all functions in compose return diffs. Extend all of them to return a change for undo/redo compatibility across all languages.
summary:
Extended all functions in compose to return Change instead of Diff across all languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#) for undo/redo compatibility.

Go: Updated 12 Kit Change Helper functions to return KitChange.
TypeScript: Added KitChange/DesignChange interfaces, updated 24+ functions, found and fixed 16 instances of apply*Diff losing base props/attributes/benchmarks when diff was empty, fixed quality.kind and quality.can_scale NOT NULL constraint violations in kitToSqlite, added type_prop table to SQLite schema for type-level props roundtrip, fixed sqliteToKit null-to-undefined conversion for file.size, file.hash, quality.kind, quality.defaultValue, quality.min, quality.max, benchmark.min, benchmark.max, stat.min, stat.max.
Python: Already had getKitChange/getDesignChange.
Engine.py: Added get_kit_change and get_design_change MCP tools.
Rust: Already had get_kit_change, get_design_change, flatten_design returning DesignChange.
C#: Updated 17 KitSqlite functions from returning Kit to KitChange, renamed region KitSqliteDiff to KitSqliteChange.

All 17 TS tests pass, Go TestChange passes, all 11 Rust tests pass, C# compiles with 0 errors.
